items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... (Percy Bryce, drums) ... What do you remember about that? [INTERVIEWEE] And Freddie Martin. Is his name there?

ctx.x: A series of musical numbers loosely strung together with a skimpy plot, interesting only for appearances by Charlie Barnet, Buddy Bregman, Harry James, George Shearing and his Quintet, (Percy Bryce, drums), and the Cal Tjader Quintet, Fats Domino and the Mills Brothers. What do you remember about that?
And Freddie Martin. Is his name there?
